query: INSERT INTO imap_accounts(link_id,user_id,sync_generation,grant_generation,credential_ciphertext,state) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links WHERE id=$1 AND macro_id=$2 AND provider='IMAP') ON CONFLICT(link_id) DO UPDATE SET sync_generation=EXCLUDED.sync_generation,grant_generation=EXCLUDED.grant_generation,credential_ciphertext=EXCLUDED.credential_ciphertext,state=jsonb_set(imap_accounts.state,'{needs_reauth}','false'::jsonb),lease_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,revision=imap_accounts.revision+1,folder_preferences_revision=imap_accounts.folder_preferences_revision+1 WHERE imap_accounts.user_id=EXCLUDED.user_id AND imap_accounts.sync_generation<=EXCLUDED.sync_generation AND imap_accounts.grant_generation<=EXCLUDED.grant_generation AND (imap_accounts.sync_generation<EXCLUDED.sync_generation OR imap_accounts.grant_generation<EXCLUDED.grant_generation)
